tools.name: find_pros
tools.description: Find local service businesses near a US ZIP code, or a town + two-letter state when no ZIP is known: "appliance_repair" (Appliance repair), "dryer_vent_cleaning" (Dryer vent cleaning), "used_appliances" (Used & scratch-and-dent appliances), "appliance_store" (Appliance store), "duct_cleaning" (Air duct cleaning), "hvac" (Heating & air conditioning (HVAC)), "plumbing" (Plumbing), "electrical" (Electrical), "roofing" (Roofing), "landscaping" (Landscaping, lawn, tree & irrigation), "cleaning" (Cleaning (home, office, carpet, pressure washing)), "pest_control" (Pest control), "locksmith" (Locksmith), "painting" (Painting), "garage_door" (Garage door repair), "handyman" (Handyman), "pool_spa" (Pool & spa service), "restoration" (Water, fire & mold restoration), "concrete_masonry" (Concrete, masonry & paving), "fence" (Fencing), "gutters" (Gutters), "septic" (Septic service), "chimney" (Chimney sweep & repair), "junk_removal" (Junk removal), "home_inspection" (Home inspection), "flooring" (Flooring), "windows_doors" (Windows & doors), "security_systems" (Home security systems), "remodeling" (Remodeling), "insulation" (Insulation), "solar" (Solar installation), "well_drilling" (Well drilling & pumps), "towing" (Towing & roadside), "auto_repair" (Auto repair), "collision" (Collision & auto glass), "diesel_truck" (Diesel & truck repair), "power_sports" (Motorcycle, marine & small engine), "welding" (Welding & fabrication), "machine_shop" (Machine shops & CNC), "computer_repair" (Computer & phone repair / IT), "heavy_equipment" (Excavation & heavy equipment), "trucking" (Trucking), "aquarium" (Aquarium service & fish). "trade" also takes plain words ("plumbers", "appliance repair"). For appliance services, optional brand (e.g. "sub-zero"), appliance (e.g. "refrigerator") and problem (e.g. "dryer not heating", "Samsung dE code") narrow it and matching free repair guides are returned first (other trades ignore them). Each result has a trust tier, distance, phone, profile link and Trust Card link (what AssistAnt verified, how and when). Commercial-only shops are left out unless segment is "commercial".

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code (or give town + state)

town.description: Town or city, e.g. "Hope Mills" (with state, when no ZIP)

trade.description: Plain-words trade, e.g. "plumbers", "appliance repair" (same as service)

service.description: Default appliance_repair. hvac = heating, furnace, heat pump and air conditioning companies.

brand.description: Appliance brand, e.g. samsung, lg, whirlpool, ge, sub-zero, viking, speed-queen

problem.description: What is wrong, in the person's words, including any error code

offset.description: Skip this many results (use next_offset from the last answer for the next page)

tools.name: get_pro_profile
tools.description: Full directory listing for one business by its profile slug (the last part of its profile URL): services, specialties, trust tier, contact, whether it can be booked online, nearby alternatives.

tools.name: get_town_summary
tools.description: For a U.S. town: how many businesses of one service (any town-page service: appliance_repair, dryer_vent_cleaning, used_appliances, hvac, plumbing, electrical, roofing, landscaping, cleaning, pest_control, locksmith, painting, garage_door, handyman, pool_spa, restoration, concrete_masonry, fence, gutters, septic, chimney, junk_removal, home_inspection, flooring, windows_doors, security_systems, remodeling, insulation, solar, well_drilling, towing, auto_repair, collision, diesel_truck, power_sports, welding, machine_shop, computer_repair, heavy_equipment, trucking) are within 25 miles, how many are verified (with the date checked), the brands they name most (appliance repair), and the list, verified first. Good for questions like "who fixes appliances in Covington, LA?" or "HVAC companies in Nashville, TN" when no ZIP is known.

tools.name: what_breaks
tools.description: What technicians actually found when they diagnosed refrigerators, washers, dryers, dishwashers or ovens/ranges, optionally for one brand (samsung, lg, whirlpool, ge, frigidaire, maytag, kenmore, hisense), as a share of diagnosed repair jobs from real repair records. Answers questions like "what usually goes wrong with my Samsung fridge?" or, with problem, "my Samsung fridge is not making ice, what is it usually?". It is not a reliability ranking. Findings marked pro_only involve gas, 240-volt power or sealed refrigerant: professional-only work, not DIY.

problem.description: Optional: what the customer says is wrong, e.g. "not making ice", "won't drain", "not heating". Returns what technicians found for THAT complaint.

tools.name: repair_cost
tools.description: What customers actually paid for appliance repair (refrigerator, washer, dryer, dishwasher, oven_range, microwave, ice_maker, or all), as typical price ranges (25th-75th percentile, rounded to $25) from TN Appliance Exchange's own job records in Middle Tennessee and South Louisiana since Sep 2022, plus the diagnostic-fee norm, what drives the price and repair-or-replace numbers (fixed on the first visit, needed a part, not fixable). Answers "how much does it cost to fix a dryer?" or "should I repair or replace my washer?". Numbers with fewer than 5 jobs behind them are left out, never guessed; quote the label and the page link. One shop's records, not a market survey.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask in plain words, e.g. "who fixes dryers in Franklin, TN?" or "HVAC near 37013". Returns a short sourced answer packet: up to 5 local businesses, each with its facts (phone, verified status with date, claimed, distance), how AssistAnt knows them, a confidence level, and what we do not know. Order: verified, then claimed, then distance; placement cannot be bought.

zip.description: Optional 5-digit ZIP (else the town is read from the question or town + state)

tools.name: check_ai_visibility
tools.description: Free AI visibility check for a business owner asking "why doesn't ChatGPT recommend my business?", "how do I show up in ChatGPT?" or "is my business visible to AI?" (GEO / AI search visibility). Returns the business's public AI Boost score (0-100 and N of 10, from facts anyone can check, each part dated), what each fix is worth in points, how it compares with claimed shops in its town, its score history, and whether ChatGPT and Claude named it in its last saved AssistAnt AI check. Takes the listing slug (returned by find_pro_by_name or find_pros). The score measures visibility to AI assistants, not the quality of the work.

slug.description: Listing slug from find_pro_by_name or find_pros

tools.name: send_claim_link
tools.description: For a business OWNER (or their AI assistant) who wants to claim their free AssistAnt 24/7 listing. Emails a one-tap claim link plus a 6-digit code to the email address ALREADY ON FILE for that business (never to an address you supply). Whoever reads that inbox opens the email and taps the link once: the listing is claimed, with a free website and the weekly AI Boost routine. Takes the listing_id (owner_tools.listing_id in find_pro_by_name results). Intended for the owner of the business or someone acting for them. If there is no email on file, it says so and gives the phone-code claim page instead.

tools.name: find_pro_by_name
tools.description: Look up a business you already know by name (e.g. "Whaley's Appliance"). Optional town + state or ZIP puts that area's matches first. Returns up to 10 matches with name, place and listing slug; the slug identifies the full listing (get_pro_profile).

name.description: Business name, or the start of it (3+ letters)

zip.description: Optional 5-digit ZIP: matches within about 60 miles

tools.name: get_pro
tools.description: One business's full public listing, by its slug or its profile URL (https://assistant247.net/pros/<slug>).

tools.name: list_trades
tools.description: Every live trade (service key + plain label), the town-page path where one exists. The keys are the service values find_pros accepts.

tools.name: list_towns
tools.description: Towns in one U.S. state the directory covers, with how many businesses of a trade (default appliance repair) are within 25 miles, most first.

trade.description: Service key or plain words, e.g. "plumbing", "hvac". Default appliance_repair.
